The top-ranked candidate (matchRank 1, matchScore 0.9481, matchConfidence 5/5, attachedToSubject=true) was identified as the confirmed target with specific per-candidate reasoning: birth year 1845 matches tree I1, birthplace Ireland matches, household includes Thomas Flynn and Mary Flynn (known parents), county correct. Rank 2 was eliminated on birth-year mismatch (1841 vs ~1845). Rank 3 was eliminated on both birth-year (1838) and birthplace (Pennsylvania) conflicts plus attachment to another person. The skill treated the match score as one input among several cross-checks, not as a verdict alone. The high score on the top match was corroborated by independent anchors (household composition, parent names, dates, place).
